metadata.phase_probe: Separate optimized thin-LTO diagnostic executables linked to the same release libraries; 40 fresh processes per revision/mode after three warmups. Timings exclude before-main OS loading, embedded-section discovery and file reads, and are not additive with production wall time.
metadata.isolation: Synthetic HOME/BAML_HOME; auto_check=false; PATH=/usr/bin:/bin; no inherited user keys/configuration/cloud destination; BAML_TOOLCHAIN points at a native fixture. Default local recordings are retained under the ignored experiment output directory.

decode_probe.methodology: 40 repeated decode-only probes in one process; before main and file reads excluded. This isolates integrity hashing from Borsh object reconstruction and does not partition production end-to-end wall time.
